name: Shanghai Film Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Film Co., Ltd., headquartered in Shanghai, China, focuses predominantly on the distribution and cinematic presentation of films throughout the country. Its operations also extend to the sale of intellectual property rights for films, as well as the financing, construction, and management of movie theaters. The company was established in 1994 and was previously known as Shanghai Oriental Television Distribution Co., Ltd. before adopting its current name in July 2012. It functions as a subsidiary of Shanghai Film (Group) Co., Ltd.
